data.one_liner: Unified lint rules for Flutter and Dart projects
data.what_it_does: Provides a predefined set of analysis rules that can be included in a project’s analysis_options.yaml. It centralises lint configuration and keeps code style consistent across multiple projects.
use_when: You want a consistent code style across several projects
You need to enforce quality standards without writing your own lints
You want to reduce setup time for new projects by reusing a ruleset
avoid_when: You need custom lints that are not part of the package
You are already using another comprehensive lints package like flutter_lints and want to avoid duplicate rules
strengths: Standardised ruleset that works for both Flutter and pure Dart
Easy to add via dev_dependencies and include in analysis_options
Updates propagate to all projects that depend on it
weaknesses: Only provides lint rules, no runtime functionality
May conflict with other lints packages if both are included
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and include package in analysis_options.yaml

alternatives.name: lints
